title: Electro-optic device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To provide an electro-optic device in which electrical damage caused when a contact hole is formed is reduced.SOLUTION: A scanning line 241 and a gate electrode 232 of a first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a first contact hole 276A, the scanning line 241 and the gate electrode 232 of a second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a second contact hole 276B, the scanning line 241 and a first light-shielding layer 254A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a third contact hole 275A, the scanning line 241 and a second light-shielding layer 254B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fourth contact hole 275B, the first light-shielding layer 254A and the gate electrode 232 of the first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fifth contact hole 280, and the second light-shielding layer 254B and the gate electrode 232 of the second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a sixth contact hole 281.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Semiconductor optical element
abstract: To distinguish the orientation of a semiconductor optical element.SOLUTION: A semiconductor optical element includes a substrate 16 which has a first side surface 20 and a second side surface 22 opposed to each other and in which the first side surface 20 is flat; the second side surface 22 includes an upper side surface 22U and a lower side surface 22L; and the lower side surface 22L protrudes from the upper side surface 22U to form a step, an optical function layer 24 which is located on the top surface of the substrate 16 and has a first end surface 26 and a second end surface 28 opposite to each other, the first end surface 26 being flush with the first side surface 20 and the second end surface 28 being flush with the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first film 42 that continuously covers the first end surface 26 and the first side surface 20, a second film 44 which is different in reflectance from the first film 42, and continuously covers the second end surface 28 and the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first electrode 38 electrically connected to the upper surface of the optical functional layer 24, and a second electrode 40 electrically connected to the lower surface of the optical functional layer 24.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Optical semiconductor element, optical unit and method for manufacturing optical unit
abstract: To simply and efficiently introduce light into a waveguide member.SOLUTION: An optical semiconductor element 10 includes: a semiconductor substrate 2 having a first main surface 2a and a second main surface 2b on the side opposite to the first main surface 2a; a laminate 3 formed on the first main surface 2a and including an active layer 33 and a contact layer 35 arranged on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 to the active layer 33; a first electrode 4 contacting the contact layer 35; and a second electrode 5 formed on the second main surface 2b. The laminate 3 includes a light transmission part 36 formed without covering at least a part 350 of a surface 35a on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 in the contact layer 35 with the first electrode 4. The optical semiconductor element 10 is constituted so as not to form a waveguide mode by current application through the first electrode 4 and a second electrode 5 in the state that the light transmission part 36 is optically in non-contact with an external member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Wire grid polarization element, manufacturing method of wire grid polarization element, projection display device and vehicle
abstract: To improve optical characteristics by inhibiting protrusions of a grid structure from being inclined due to deposition of a functional film.SOLUTION: A wire grid polarization element 1 comprises: a substrate 10; a grid structure 20 obtained by integrally forming a base part 21 and a plurality of protrusions 22; a functional film 30 covering a part of the protrusion 22; and a reinforced film 51. The reinforced film 51 includes inorganic oxide, is interposed between the part of the protrusion 33 covered by the functional film 30 and the functional film 30 to reinforce the protrusion 22. The reinforced film 51 covers and envelopes at least a tip 22a and an upper side of both side faces 22b of the protrusion 22. The functional film 30 covers and envelopes a top of the protrusion 22 via the reinforced film 51 while does not cover a bottom side of the protrusion 22 and the base part 21, and has a coverage factor (Rc) of 30% or more and 70% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 25

title: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title: Fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of antistaling agents. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender provided by the invention comprises pullulan polysaccharide, fulvic acid, potassium chloride and sodium benzoate, and the components act together, so that compared with the existing fresh cut flower flowering phase extender in the market, the fresh cut flower flowering phase extender has the characteristics of small dosage, low cost, cold resistance, heat resistance and lasting effect, and has a good effect of prolonging the fresh cut flower flowering phase within the range of 5-25 ℃. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender formula does not contain silver salt with strong physiological toxicity and environmental pollution, and is efficient, environment-friendly and environment-friendly; has antibacterial, antiseptic, nutrient supplementing, and water metabolism balancing effects; the preparation method is scientific, reasonable, simple and feasible.

title: Preparation method and application of livestock breeding feed taking fruit wine residues as raw materials
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of livestock-raising feed using fruit wine residues as raw materials, which are applied to the field of feed preparation, and aim to solve the problems of low utilization rate of fruit wine residues, feed resource waste, low cultivation benefit and the like; according to the method, the fruit wine residues are pretreated and accurately compounded, mineral substances adsorbent optimized structures are added to perform mixing tempering, multistage collaborative fermentation, dynamic regulation and control of the fermentation process, intermittent stirring and weak forced ventilation are performed during regulation and control, and finally drying granulation is performed, so that the emission of harmful gases in the fermentation process is effectively controlled, the stable fermentation environment is maintained, the availability of proteins and trace elements in the feed is obviously improved, the fruit wine residues which are difficult to treat originally are converted into high-quality livestock feed with balanced nutrition, waste materials of wine byproducts are turned into wealth, and the problem of environmental pollution of waste is solved.

title: Preparation Method of Multidimensional Anti-Aging Nutrient
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of anti-aging technologies, and particularly to a preparation method of a multidimensional anti-aging nutrient. The multidimensional anti-aging nutrient includes anti-aging granules and a beauty nourishing oral liquid, wherein the anti-aging granules includes the raw materials: 10 g of Cistanche deserticola , 10 g of Morinda officinalis , 4 chrysanthemums, 10 g of Chinese wolfberry, ethanol, 10 g of lactose, 10 g of sucrose, 5 g of microcrystalline cellulose and 1 g of magnesium stearate; a process for preparing the anti-aging granules is as follows: step S1, soaking 10 g of Cistanche deserticola with yellow rice wine, then baking the soaked Cistanche deserticola , respectively smashing 10 g of Morinda officinalis without cores and 4 chrysanthemums without calyx to pass through a 20-mesh sieve, extracting the Cistanche deserticola with 60% ethanol, with a material-to-liquid ratio of 1:10, and then soaking for 30 min.

title: Functional plant solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a functional plant solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the functional plant solid beverage comprises the following components in percentage by mass: the sea-buckthorn health beverage is prepared from 15% of sea-buckthorn, 15% of white mulberry, 12% of dandelion, 12% of polygonatum odoratum, 12% of rhizoma polygonati, 30% of black fruit micromolecule peptide, 1% of riboflavin and 3% of monosaccharide, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing the following components in percentage by mass: sea-buckthorn, white mulberry, dandelion, polygonatum, rhizoma polygonati, black fruit small molecular peptide, riboflavin and monosaccharide; baking fructus Hippophae, Mori fructus, herba Taraxaci, rhizoma Polygonati Odorati, rhizoma Polygonati, small molecular peptide of fructus Nicandrae, riboflavin, and monosaccharide at low temperature for more than 24 hr; and putting the baked components into a high-speed powder grinding machine according to the weight part ratio for wall breaking treatment, and sieving by a sieve of 80-100 meshes to obtain superfine mixed powder. The invention can quickly and effectively dissolve fat and thrombolysis, reduce cholesterol and supplement various trace elements required by human body.

title: Miniature DI input detection method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature DI input detection method and device, the method comprises the steps that an input module obtains passive or active switching value signals and transmits the signals to an input detection protection module, the input detection protection module carries out signal conversion and detection on the switching value signals, different voltages are obtained according to different input switching value signals and output to an output control module, and the output control module outputs and obtains the level of a current switching value conversion output result according to different voltage values output to the output control module. The invention establishes a set of miniature DI input detection device with low power consumption, high reliability, low cost and small volume through simple separation components, and realizes compatible input detection of passive switching value and active switching value through the device.

title: Circuit arrangement and real-time clock device
abstract: To provide a circuit arrangement that prevents a reduction in reliability of temperature compensation, while quickly switching power supply voltage.SOLUTION: A circuit arrangement 100 includes an oscillation circuit 150, a temperature sensor 162, an A/D conversion circuit 164, a processing circuit 120, and a power supply circuit 110. The oscillation circuit 150 has a variable capacitance circuit 156, and with the setting of the capacity of the variable capacitance circuit 156 with a capacity setting value CP, an oscillatory frequency is adjusted. When a first power supply voltage switching operation is performed which is to switch a power supply voltage from a first power supply voltage VDD to a second power supply voltage VBAT in an A/D conversion period of the A/D conversion circuit 164, the processing circuit 120 stops the update of the capacity setting value CP to be output to the variable capacitance circuit 156.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title: Slope feedback control circuit and micro-processing chip
abstract: The application provides a slope feedback control circuit and a micro-processing chip. The slope feedback control circuit comprises a driving circuit, a detection circuit, a constant current circuit and an LIN bus, wherein the driving circuit comprises a driving tube and a first capacitor, a first input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a control end of the driving tube, a second input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a transmitting signal end, an output end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a first input end of the constant current circuit, a second input end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the transmitting signal end, an output end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a first end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a second end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to a first voltage end, an input end of the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube, and the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube. The application improves the reliability of signal detection.

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Bias circuit and radio frequency power amplifier
abstract: The utility model discloses a bias circuit and a radio frequency power amplifier, which belong to the technical field of high-power lasers, wherein the bias circuit comprises a programmable digital-to-analog conversion module, an enabling signal end of the module is respectively connected with one end of a filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 and one end of a voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , the other end of the filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 is grounded, an external enabling signal is connected with the external enabling signal through the other end of the voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , and the external enabling signal is input to the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module after voltage stabilization and capacitance filtering, so that the output voltage of the module can be stabilized, the precision requirement of digital-to-analog conversion is ensured, the precision control of the required bias voltage is realized, and the stability and the precision of the bias voltage are further ensured. Meanwhile, when the power amplification chip changes, parameters of the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module can be flexibly adjusted. Based on the method, the complexity of the bias circuit can be reduced and the flexibility of the bias circuit can be improved on the premise of ensuring stability and accuracy.

title: Multifunctional catalyst, producing method thereof and use method thereof
abstract: To provide a multifunctional catalyst used for recycling polyester fabric, a producing method thereof, and a use method thereof.SOLUTION: A multifunctional catalyst 100 includes a carrier S, a first functional ionic liquid IL-1 and a second functional ionic liquid IL-2 grafted onto the carrier. The carrier is an inorganic composite powder material and is composed of a chemical component shown as C:Na-Ni/Al2O3. During recycling of polyester fabric, multifunctional catalysts can simultaneously decolorize and depolymerize polyester textiles. The first functional ionic liquid is used to decolorize the polyester fabric, and the second functional ionic liquid is used to depolymerize the polyester fabric.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Molecular sieve membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a molecular sieve membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the membrane thickness of the molecular sieve membrane is 10-500 mu m, preferably 30-200 mu m. The invention provides a preparation method of a molecular sieve membrane, which comprises the following steps: a) Preparing a colloid slurry from molecular sieve seed crystals, a silicon source, water, optionally an aluminum source, optionally a colloid stabilizer; b) Uniformly dispersing the colloid slurry on the surface of a carrier framework, and drying to obtain a blank; c) And (3) carrying out heat treatment on the green body in the presence of organic amine to convert the surface coating of the green body into a molecular sieve membrane. According to the method, the thickness of the molecular sieve film can be effectively adjusted, meanwhile, the organic amine solution and the coating slurry are prepared separately, and the coating slurry can be repeatedly used; the crystallized organic amine solution can be repeatedly used or recycled because of almost no chemical change, so that the amount of waste mother liquor is greatly reduced, and the method is particularly suitable for industrial production.

title: Composite body, catalytic ink, and method for manufacturing composite body
abstract: Provided is a composite body comprising molybdenum disulfide and molybdenum trioxide, in which the molybdenum disulfide contains a 3R crystal structure, the content of molybdenum in terms of a molybdenum trioxide (B) calculated from the molybdenum content determined by the XRF analysis of the composite body relative to the whole mass of the composite body is 5 to 90% by mass. Also provided is a catalytic ink comprising the composite body and a solvent. Also provided is a method for manufacturing the composite body, the method comprising a burning step for heating molybdenum trioxide at a temperature of 400 DEG C or lower in the presence of a sulfur source.

title: Hyperbranched polymer, metal recovery agent, metal recovery method and catalytic activity inhibitor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a novel hyperbranched polymer having high metal capturing capability and capable of being used as a metal recovery agent and a catalytic activity inhibitor. SOLUTION: A hyperbranched polymer represented by the following formula (1) and having a weight average molecular weight of 1000 to 1000000 is provided. In the formula, A 1 is a group containing an aromatic ring, A 2 is a group containing an amide group, A 3 is a group containing sulfur, m1 is 0.5 to 11, and n1 is 5 to 100. title: Special nano composite auxiliary agent for ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a special nano composite auxiliary agent for ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: 10-25% of an anti-sticking agent, 20-30% of an antioxidant, 25-35% of an inorganic nano adsorption-nucleating agent, 5-15% of an acid absorption stabilizer, 10-15% of a rheological additive and 0.01-0.1% of a yellow finger control agent. The preparation technology comprises the following steps: 1) Uniformly mixing the anti-sticking agent, the inorganic nano adsorption-nucleating agent, the rheological auxiliary agent and the yellow index control agent by using a high-speed stirring device to perform; 2) Uniformly reinforcing the preformed component and other components into a composite material by adopting a gravity-free mixing device; 3) And curing the composite material at low temperature through parallel double screws, and finally obtaining the composite additive with uniform size through a granule pressing forming and screening device. The composite additive is used for the special material of the ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin, and can obtain the cast polypropylene aluminized film with excellent comprehensive properties such as good optics, mechanics, anti-adhesion, processing molding, precipitation resistance, thermo-oxidative aging resistance and the like. In addition, the composite auxiliary agent has the characteristics of integration, easy addition, small addition amount, low-temperature preparation, environmental protection and the like, scientifically solves the problems of accurate regulation and control of dust-free environment in the preparation process of the nano composite auxiliary agent and dust-free addition of the composite auxiliary agent in the production process of the special polypropylene resin material, and is a special high-performance composite auxiliary agent for the cast polypropylene aluminized film resin.

title: Waste gas purifying device capable of purifying in multiple stages
abstract: The utility model discloses a waste gas purifying device capable of purifying in multiple stages, which comprises a main body, a purifying box, a controller and a fixing plate, wherein the purifying box is arranged on the outer wall of the main body, the controller is arranged on the inner wall of the purifying box, a plurality of filter screens are arranged on the inner wall of the main body, the fixing plate is arranged on the inner wall of the main body, a motor is arranged on the top wall of the inner part of the main body, and a storage device is arranged on the top of the fixing plate. The utility model can conveniently carry out multistage purification by installing the controller, the storage cavity is provided with a plurality of purifying liquids, when waste gas is required to be purified, the water pump is started, the purifying liquids are pumped out by the water pump, the water outlet pipe is respectively connected with the controller, when the waste gas is purified, the water outlet pipe can drive the winding shaft to rotate by starting the motor, the winding shaft drives the cable to shrink, and simultaneously the cable drives the sealing plate to seal the spraying pipe, so that the types of the spraying purifying liquids are controlled, and the spraying can be simultaneously carried out, thereby realizing the multistage purification function.

title: Reduction circulation desulfurization device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of desulfurization, in particular to a reduction circulation desulfurization device which comprises a desulfurization tower, wherein the inner wall of the bottom of the desulfurization tower is provided with a box body, the top of the box body is provided with two mounting holes, the two mounting holes are internally provided with control components for controlling alkali liquor in the desulfurization tower to enter the box body, and an aeration component is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for injecting air into the alkali liquor in the box body.

title: RTO heat accumulation formula incinerator tail gas treatment equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an RTO heat accumulating type incinerator tail gas treatment device which comprises four support columns, a box body, a gas inlet pipe, a gas outlet pipe, a driving motor, a second rotating rod and a cooling mechanism, wherein the box body is arranged at the tops of the four support columns, the box body is provided with a box door convenient to overhaul, the gas inlet pipe is sleeved with one side of the box body, the gas outlet pipe is sleeved at one side of the box body, which is far away from the gas inlet pipe, the driving motor is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the box body, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the second rotating rod, and the cooling mechanism is arranged at one side of the box body, which is close to the gas inlet pipe; the cooling mechanism further comprises a water tank, a first supporting plate, a first rotating rod, a stirring blade, a hollow box, a fourth connecting pipe, an atomizing spray head, a filter box, a sponge, a filter screen, a sleeve barrel, a box cover, a hose, a triangular block, a movable connector, a water pump, a second connecting pipe and a first connecting pipe, wherein the water tank is fixedly connected to one side, close to the air inlet pipe, of the top of the box body.

title: Reduced iron shaft furnace cooling circulating water treatment device
abstract: The utility model discloses a reduced iron shaft furnace refrigeration cycle water treatment facilities, which comprises a tank body, the upper end fixed mounting of the jar body has the go-between, the upper end fixed mounting of go-between has the top cap, the upper end fixed mounting of top cap has the input mouth, the lower extreme fixed mounting of the jar body has the support column, the lower extreme swing joint of support column has the bottom plate, one side fixed mounting of the jar body has the oral siphon, the one end fixed mounting of oral siphon has the connector, the vent has been seted up to the opposite side of the jar body, the inside fixed mounting of the jar body has the filter layer, the inside below fixed mounting of the jar body has the immersible pump, one side fixedly connected with water pipe of immersible pump, the opposite side below fixed mounting of the jar body has the outlet pipe. The utility model provides a water treatment device with a filtering effect, avoids influencing the service life because of too much rust, and provides a radiating function, thereby having practicability.

title: Water-cooling system of electric vibration chute
abstract: The utility model discloses a water cooling system of an electric vibration chute, which comprises: the cooling box is arranged outside the electric vibration chute, a filter box is fixedly connected to one end below the cooling box, a water storage chamber is fixedly connected to one end of the side face of the filter box, the water storage chamber is fixedly connected with the upper cooling box, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the side face of the water storage chamber, a water pump is connected to one end of the side face of the water inlet pipe in a threaded manner, and a water delivery pipe is connected to one end of the side face of the water pump in a threaded manner; according to the utility model, the recycling of water resources is realized through the mechanisms such as the cooling tank, the filtering tank and the water storage chamber, the waste of the water resources is avoided, a better working environment is created, the filtering tank mechanism can filter the recycled water, the residual particle impurities on the filter screen can be cleaned, the impurities can be cleaned in time, and the problems that the spray head cannot be cooled normally due to the blockage of the particle impurities and the impurities in the filter system are difficult to clean are solved.

title: Upset pushes down mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides a mechanism is pushed down in upset, it includes: the fixing frame comprises a fixing plate and two mounting plates, and the inner side walls of the lower ends of the two mounting plates are respectively provided with arc chutes which are symmetrical to each other; the pressing assembly comprises a pressing piece, a rotating shaft and a sliding rod, the pressing piece is horizontally arranged between the two mounting plates, the rotating shaft and the sliding rod are vertically arranged at one end, close to the mounting plates, of the pressing piece, two ends of the rotating shaft are respectively connected with the pressing piece and the mounting plates in a rotating mode, one end of the sliding rod is horizontally and fixedly connected with the pressing piece, and the other end of the sliding rod is inserted into the arc-shaped sliding groove and can slide up and down along the arc-shaped sliding groove; the turnover assembly comprises a telescopic element and a connecting frame, the connecting frame is enclosed outside the fixing frame, a strip-shaped groove is horizontally formed in the connecting frame, the sliding rod is inserted into the strip-shaped groove, and the telescopic element is used for driving the connecting frame to move up and down. The utility model discloses a mechanism is pushed down in upset, simple structure, the volume is light and handy, and process flow is simple, and the operating efficiency is high, easily production and use.

title: Retention mechanism, transfer device, handling robot system, and unloading device
abstract: To provide a retention mechanism, a transfer device, a handling robot system, and an unloading device that are capable of easily holding an article.SOLUTION: A retention mechanism includes: a base having one end, a structure connection mechanism, a drive part, and a regulation member. The structure connection mechanism includes a connection member for connecting at least two or more structures with the structure, and is rotatable in a first rotation direction about a first shaft, whereas partly restricted in rotation in a second rotation direction about the first shaft. The regulation member is provided at a prescribed distance from the one end. The drive part moves the structure connection mechanism in a first direction from the one end toward the regulation member. According to drive of the drive part, a projection part of the structure connection mechanism projecting beyond the one end projects in a second direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction after passing between the one end and the regulation member. The regulation member regulates movement of the projection part in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Nut processing equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a nut processing equipment relates to mechanical equipment technical field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the fixed mount that is provided with of base top central point department of putting, and the cross-section of mount is the hexagon, the inside both ends swing joint of mount has rather than the matched with slip grip block. The utility model discloses mount overall structure is the hexagon structure, the inside both ends of mount all swing joint have the slip grip block, two sets of slip grip block both sides are all fixed be provided with mount looks sliding connection's slider, it rotates to drive two sets of two-way lead screw simultaneously through two sets of motors, and two sets of two-way lead screw run through two sets of sliders respectively, the rotation of two-way lead screw, make two sets of slip grip blocks can do the slip that is close to mutually or keeps away from mutually, the distance of carrying out between two sets of slip grip blocks can be adjusted, adaptation specification that can be fine is hexagon nut's processing in the certain limit size, the suitability is comparatively extensive, it is comparatively convenient to.

title: Supporting clamp with anti-drop structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a supporting clamp with an anti-falling structure, which comprises an installation fixing base, wherein a plurality of screw holes are formed in the periphery of the upper end of the installation fixing base, a telescopic supporting column is arranged on the installation fixing base, the bottom end of the telescopic supporting column is fixedly connected with the upper end of the mounting and fixing base through welding, the top end of the telescopic supporting column is fixedly connected with a fixing block, the upper end of the fixing block is provided with a groove, the groove is transversely arranged on the fixed block, the middle position of the front end of the fixed block is provided with a connecting hole, the connecting hole penetrates through the fixed block, the fixed block is movably connected with a connecting rod, the top end of the connecting rod is movably connected with an anti-falling device, anti-drop device rear end fixedly connected with U-shaped connecting block, connecting rod top swing joint is inboard at U-shaped connecting block, anti-drop device front end intermediate position is through pasting the fixedly connected with sucking disc. The mobile phone shell polishing device effectively prevents the mobile phone shell from falling off during polishing, and is convenient for adjusting the polishing angle of a product.

title: Roller car
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of sewing equipment, and discloses a roller car which comprises a workbench, wherein a rotating shuttle structure, a cutting structure for cutting off a thread and a feeding structure for driving a material to move are arranged on the workbench; the workbench comprises a bottom plate, wherein an upright post and a supporting plate are arranged above the bottom plate, the supporting plate is positioned on one side of the upright post, the upper end surface of the supporting plate is higher than the upper end surface of the upright post, and a vertical hole penetrating through the bottom plate is formed in the upper end surface of the upright post; the rotating structure comprises a rotating shuttle shaft which is rotatably arranged in the vertical hole; the feeding structure comprises a feeding sleeve which is rotatably arranged in the vertical hole, and the feeding sleeve is sleeved outside the rotating shuttle shaft; the rotating shuttle shaft, the feeding sleeve and the vertical hole are coaxially arranged, and the rotating shuttle shaft feeding device has the effect of reducing the size.

title: Map data storage device, control method, program, and storage medium
abstract: To provide a map data storage device capable of suitably updating map data without generating deviation in an update frequency based on a traffic volume at a point where a change point is detected.SOLUTION: A server device 2 acquires: change point candidate data generated by comparing peripheral information based on an output of a sensor part 17 with a partial map DB12; and traffic volume information at an acquisition point of the change point candidate data. The server device 2 then sets a weight W for each of the acquired change point candidate data on the basis of the traffic volume information, and updates a distribution map DB21 on the basis of the change point candidate data for which the weight W has been set.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Information notification device, information notification system, and information notification method
abstract: To provide an information notification device that notifies an operator of information and is capable of further accurately providing notification with simple configuration.SOLUTION: An information notification device 100 includes: an operation state information acquisition unit 111 that acquires operation state information of a manufacturing device; and an operation determination unit 112 that determines an operation state of the manufacturing device. The information notification device 100 also includes a wireless signal information acquisition unit that acquires received power information indicating received power of a wireless signal transmitted from the manufacturing device to a portable terminal. The information notification device 100 also includes a position calculation unit 114 that calculates an operator distance from the manufacturing device to the operator based on the received power information. The information notification device 100 also includes a distance determination unit 115 that determines, based on the operator distance and a determination distance, a distance of the operator. The information notification device 100 further includes an abnormality information transmission unit 116 that transmits abnormality information to the portable terminal of the operator upon determination that the operator distance is greater than or equal to the determination distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Intelligent analysis system and method for communication data
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis system and method for communication data, which relate to the technical field of data transmission, wherein the system comprises the steps of acquiring an intelligent household equipment list; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target household scene information interactively, carrying out equipment application analysis on the target household scene information to obtain a target application household equipment set, constructing a communication analysis cloud, carrying out matching mapping and resource analysis on a household equipment control model group to obtain a target equipment control model set, and carrying out communication control on the target application household equipment set based on a household equipment control parameter set. Solves the technical problems that the prior household equipment communication data analysis has insufficient data island and equipment compatibility, so that the user needs are difficult to be matched accurately, and the analysis processing of the communication data is not accurate, comprehensive and intelligent, the intelligent household device has the advantages that the comprehensive capture, intelligent analysis and accurate control of communication data among intelligent household devices are realized, and the technical effects of improving the analysis accuracy and the intellectualization of the communication data are achieved.

title: Evaluation system, method, device, equipment and medium for cloud control basic platform regulation instruction
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an evaluation system, a method, a device, equipment and a medium of a cloud control basic platform regulation instruction, wherein in the system, a road end subsystem comprises a road end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired road end time information to an instruction evaluation subsystem, a cloud end subsystem comprises a data acquisition module used for transmitting cloud end time information and external data to the instruction evaluation subsystem, a vehicle end subsystem comprises a vehicle end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired vehicle end time information to the instruction evaluation subsystem, the instruction evaluation subsystem is used for acquiring the road end time information, cloud end time information and vehicle end time information, aligning the road end time information, the cloud end time information and the vehicle end time information with the time information of the instruction evaluation subsystem, calculating the value of a regulation instruction evaluation index according to the time information of each subsystem after alignment, and the reliability of a regulation instruction evaluation result is improved by adopting the technical scheme.

title: Processing system, processing device, processing method, and processing program

title: Compositions and methods for treatment of kidney diseases
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods and compositions for increasing the expression of a protein, and for treating a subject in need thereof, e.g., a subject with deficient protein expression or a subject having a kidney disease. SOLUTION: Provided is a method comprising the step of contacting the cells of a subject with an antisense oligomer (ASO), which is complementary to the targeted portion of RIC pre-mRNA encoding a target protein or functional RNA, whereby the retained intron is constitutively spliced from the RIC pre-mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, thereby increasing the level of mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, and in the cells of the subject, increasing the expression of the target protein or functional RNA. title: Chemical composition and method for using the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a probe for sequencing, a reporter probe and a method in which nucleic acid sequencing that is quickly executed with no enzyme, no amplification and no library, and has a low error rate with a long read-out length. SOLUTION: A probe including a primary nucleic acid molecule which hybridizes with at least six secondary nucleic acid molecules, in which each of the plurality of secondary nucleic acid molecules hybridizes with at least five tertiary nucleic acid molecules, and each of the tertiary nucleic acid molecules includes at least one detectable label. title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. title: Anti-her2 combinations for treating cancer
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a therapeutic combination for treating cancer by using combinational therapy. SOLUTION: A therapeutic combination comprises: (i) an effective amount of a Her2/Neu antagonist, such as an antibody or a functional fragment thereof that specifically binds to Her2/Neu (e.g., anti-Her2 antibody); and (ii) an effective amount of an immunotherapeutic that is capable of activating a human plasmacytoid dendritic cell, myeloid dendritic cell, or NK cell, or a combination thereof. title: Method for analyzing carboxyl terminal amino acid
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a novel method for analyzing an amino acid of a carboxyl terminal (C terminal) of a polypeptide. SOLUTION: The present invention provides a method for analyzing an amino acid of a C terminal of a polypeptide. The method includes the steps of (a) enzyme-treating one or plural polypeptides in an isotope-labelled solution with carboxy peptidase, and (b) detecting an amino acid not labelled with an isotope as an amino acid of a C terminal. title: Composite components of a golf club head
abstract: A composite material for a component of a golf club head is disclosed herein. The composite material includes a composite layers and at least one an interlaminar layer that includes one of vertically aligned carbon nanotubes, Z-Axis aligned carbon fibers or graphene platelets. In one preferred embodiment, the golf club head component is a face component.

title: Light beauty board
abstract: The invention discloses a light-weight beauty board, which relates to the technical field of building boards and comprises a structural bottom plate, wherein the top of the structural bottom plate is provided with a material extruding mechanism, the top of the material extruding mechanism is provided with a discharging mechanism, the outer side of the material extruding mechanism is provided with a heat preservation mechanism, the top of the structural bottom plate is provided with a die casting mechanism, and the inside of the die casting mechanism is provided with a beauty board body. The invention improves the structural strength of the plate and effectively lightens the whole quality of the plate through the use of the PET plate, the glass fiber net and the light quartz plate in the body of the American clean plate, thereby greatly improving the applicability of the device, leading the plate to meet different market demands, extruding PET raw materials into a die of a die casting mechanism for die casting molding through a blanking mechanism and an extruding mechanism, greatly improving the production efficiency of the plate, simplifying the production operation, and further effectively reducing the production cost.

title: Preparation method of ruthenium compound for protein fluorescent staining
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ruthenium compound for protein fluorescent staining, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving hydrated ruthenium trichloride and sodium erythrophenanthroline disulfonate hydrate in ethylene glycol, and heating to react; s2: and (3) dropwise adding the solution after the reaction of S1 into diethyl ether in a stirring state, crystallizing, filtering and drying to obtain the tris (4, 7-diphenyl-1, 10-phenanthroline disulfonate) ruthenium tetrasodium salt. The preparation method of the invention is safe, efficient and easy to operate, has low equipment requirement, simple post-treatment, almost can quantitatively obtain a qualified target substance, and well solves the technical blank of the preparation and purification of the compound.

title: Welding jig device and production method for component
abstract: To facilitate a welding operation. A device is used for forming a part (5) by welding a plurality of members (W) together, and includes a jig (10) on one side having a joint face (12) on one side, which is adapted to contact one of faces (W11) exposed on the outer surface sides of the plurality of members (W) overlaid one on top of the other, and an opening (13) on one side corresponding to a portion of desired welded portions (53) of the part (5); a jig (20) on another side having a joint face (22) on the other side, which is adapted to contact another face (W21) of the faces exposed on the outer surface sides of the plurality of members (W), and an opening (23) on the other side corresponding to another portion of the desired welded portions (53) of the part (5) and not corresponding to the opening (13) on one side; a laser welding machine (2A) on one side that is configured to emit a laser beam toward the opening (13) on one side; and a laser welding machine (2B) on the other side that is configured to emit a laser beam toward the opening (23) on the other side.

title: Multilayer PE nano clean tube and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of high molecular tubes, in particular to a multilayer PE nano clean tube and a preparation method thereof, comprising a physical barrier layer, a high-density PE shell, an inner liner layer and a buffer layer, wherein the inner liner layer is sleeved outside the physical barrier layer, the buffer layer cover is located outside the inner liner, the outside of buffer layer is located to high density PE shell cover, the inner wall of physical barrier layer is provided with the guiding gutter, the inner wall of inner liner is provided with the holding tank. According to the invention, through the diversion trench, the containing groove and the buffer layer, the cleaning effect can be improved while the bacteria breeding dead angle on the inner wall of the pipe is avoided, and the normal operation of the semiconductor process is effectively ensured.
